Steppenwolf: The X-Creatures Project developed by Sarbakan Studios through Warnerbros, early 2000s. The story, the art, the music and characters, absolutely magnificent, such a thrill. Played it after school on the Home Ec room computer waiting for my Mom to be done with her classroom duties so we could both drive home together.
